findings.design: SessionLayout renders Shell.AppSidebar (active='Sessions') as a permanent left nav rail alongside the header/content/agent split, per the design's 'Split-panel study interface' description.
findings.app: The page uses `definePageMeta({ layout: 'minimal' })`, which renders only a thin top bar (logo + 'Back to dashboard' link) with no sidebar/nav at all during a session.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.element: Simultaneous Reading + Quiz cards in content column
findings.design: For the 'answering-unsubmitted' state, leftContent stacks a ReadingBlock and a QuizCard together in the same viewport (reading context directly above its related question).
findings.app: The content column renders a single `currentItem` at a time via `v-if="type==='quiz'" / v-else", driven by one `currentPos` index — a ReadingBlock and QuizCard are never shown together; the user must advance through discrete reading-only or quiz-only screens.

findings.design: ConfidenceRating is its own leftContent card that appears only after submission (state 'submitted-incorrect'), alongside the now-submitted QuizCard. In 'answering-unsubmitted', no confidence UI exists and the Submit button has no extra precondition beyond selecting an option.
findings.app: ConfidenceRating is embedded inside QuizCard and shown BEFORE submission (`v-if="result === null"`); `canSubmit` requires both an option AND a confidence value, so the Submit button stays disabled until confidence is rated pre-submission — inverting the design's submit-then-rate flow.

findings.design: Prompt reads "How confident do you feel about **IAM & SCPs**?" — bolded, topic-specific context.
findings.app: Generic prompt "How confident do you feel?" with no topic/domain interpolation.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: Reading pill is followed by a domain label (e.g. 'IAM & Security') for context.
findings.app: ReadingBlock renders the domain span only `v-if="domain"`, but the page never passes a `domain` prop when invoking `<ReadingBlock>`, so the label never renders.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: The ReadingBlock component has no advance/continue affordance — it ends with the citation chips, since (per finding above) the related quiz is shown directly beneath it.
findings.app: ReadingBlock adds its own bottom 'Continue →' button to advance the single-item sequence, a control not present in the design component.

findings.design: Collapsed AgentPanel shows a chat-bubble icon button plus a vertical 'Ask AI' label alongside the expand control.
findings.app: Collapsed state (`w-11`) keeps only the header row's toggle arrow button; no icon or 'Ask AI' label is rendered.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: Header shows a small green dot next to 'Study assistant' indicating live/online status.
findings.app: Header shows only the 'Study assistant' text and the collapse/close button — no status dot.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: Non-user bubbles show a small circular sparkle-icon avatar before the 'Study assistant' label.
findings.app: AgentBubble renders only the 'Study assistant' text label, no avatar icon.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: Label reads 'Q3 of 12' with no space between 'Q' and the number.
findings.app: Template inserts a literal space: "Q {{ displayNumber(item.index) }} of {{ total }}", rendering 'Q 3 of 12'.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

intentionalProductContracts.colorModes: Dark and light modes use semantic Readion tokens and meet 4.5:1 normal-text and 3:1 large-text/non-text minimum contrast.
intentionalProductContracts.controls: Controls expose rest, hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, selected, and action-local busy states with stable dimensions, reduced-motion handling, semantic state, duplicate guards, and operation-specific labels.
intentionalProductContracts.async: HTTP regions distinguish initial loading, content, successful empty, error with Retry, and content-preserving background refresh.
intentionalProductContracts.accessibility: Progress and outcomes are announced; modal focus enters a meaningful control, traps traversal, supports permitted Escape/backdrop dismissal, and returns to the opener.
intentionalProductContracts.responsive: Implemented shell screens contain content at 375px with wrapping or bounded local overflow while preserving the desktop artboard hierarchy.
